items.t: 2027 GRIs at 5.9%, one point above the 2018 increase
items.body: FedEx announced its 2027 GRI on 2026-09-18 for an effective date of Jan. 4, 2027, at a 5.9% average. UPS announced on 2026-10-23 for Dec. 21, 2026, also at 5.9%. For the 2018 GRI, FedEx announced on 2017-09-18 for Jan. 1, 2018, and UPS announced on 2017-10-25 for Dec. 24, 2017, both at 4.9%. FedEx's 2023 figure was 6.9%, and 5.9% was the headline for 2024, 2025 and 2026 as well.

items.t: Surcharges rise faster than the 5.9% headline for 2027
items.body: An analysis published Nov. 6, 2026 says all 20 of the most common UPS surcharges rise more than 5.9%, averaging 9.1%. FedEx Additional Handling moves from $29.50-$40.75 to $31.75-$43.75 by zone, and a residential delivery charge goes from $6.95 to $7.35. UPS raises the Additional Handling minimum billable weight from 40 lb, the figure set with its 2025 increase, to 50 lb and adds an origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver whose amount is not stated.

items.t: 2026 peak fees top 2025 levels; 2018 had no residential fee
items.body: For the Nov. 23-Dec. 27, 2026 window, FedEx lists Ground residential at $0.80 (vs $0.65 in 2025), Additional Handling at $11.85 (vs $10.90) and Oversize at $117.25 (vs $108.50). UPS lists Large Package at $117.50 for Nov. 22-Dec. 26, 2026, against $107 in 2025. In 2018 FedEx applied no residential peak surcharge and peak Additional Handling of +$3.20 and Oversize of +$27.50.

items.t: USPS: three 2026 price steps outside January, 2018 had one
items.body: In 2026 USPS made two mid-year moves: a temporary 8% parcel increase effective Apr. 26 (announced Mar. 25) and, effective July 12 (announced May 11), a Ground Advantage Commercial change averaging 11.8% plus a DIM divisor cut from 166 to 139. The Nov. 12 filing, pending PRC review, would take effect Jan. 17, 2027, with a 5.9% average increase and an 11% fuel surcharge replacing the 8% charge. In 2018 USPS had one January change of 3.9%, and in 2021 it noted no fuel surcharges.

items.t: Fuel tables at 30%, against a 20% record in June 2025
items.body: UPS's Nov. 2, 2026 tables put Ground at 30.00% for diesel of $6.25-$6.34. Tables announced Nov. 12 and effective Nov. 16 add 0.50 points per band. FedEx's Nov. 9 Ground table runs from 30.00% to 31.50%. In June 2025 UPS and FedEx Ground both reached a record 20%, and the earlier peak was FedEx at 19.50% in mid-2022.

items.t: Per-pound international fees now exceed 2025 peak range
items.body: UPS raised its China/Hong Kong/Macau-to-U.S. Surge Emergency Fee from $0.91 to $1.03 per lb, announced Nov. 12 and effective Nov. 16, 2026. FedEx added Vietnam-origin import surcharges of $0.36 (priority) and $0.27 (economy) per lb effective Nov. 2, 2026. In 2025 the UPS and FedEx international peak fees ran $0.10 to $0.52 per lb. UPS's Middle East fee of $1.34 per lb has been in place since Mar. 22, 2026.
